d:
The Timberwolves defeated the Trail Blazers, 106-105 tonight in Minnesota. Ayo Dosunmu finished with a team-high 30 points along with 7 three pointers and 5 assists for the Timberwolves, while Jaden McDaniels tallied 22 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Damian Lillard recorded 25 points, 5 assists and 5 three pointers. The Timberwolves improve their record to 11-4 with the win, while the Trail Blazers fall to 9-5 for the season.
